p.AI Tagging: /settings/automation/ai-tagging ::  AI Tagging Let AI tag tickets from each department's existing tags. Auto-tagging is off in your AI policy Auto-tagging is turned off in your AI policy. An administrator with AI policy permission can enable it. Automatic tagging Tag tickets automatically Off by default. AI picks only from the department's existing tags, only adds tags, and never adds back a tag an agent removed. Departments Whose tickets AI tags. All departments Only selected departments Maximum tags per ticket AI adds at most this many tags to a ticket (1–5). 3 Minimum confidence AI adds a tag only when it is at least this sure. 60% Tag again when the customer replies A customer's reply on an existing ticket can add more tags. AI tagging also notes each ticket's sentiment, so the Tags page can show trending topics. Save
p.Ticket Archiving: /settings/tickets/archiving ::  Ticket Archiving Automatically archive tickets nobody has touched for a while, so your views stay focused on current work. Auto-archive Archive inactive tickets automatically Checked every 6 hours. Archived tickets leave every view except Archived Tickets. Archive after this many days without activity Between 7 and 1095 days. Only closed tickets Leave open tickets alone, however long they have been quiet. A new customer message or agent reply on an archived ticket brings it back automatically. Save Spam tickets Delete spam tickets automatically Spam tickets older than the days below move to the Recycle Bin. Delete spam after (days) Between 7 and 365 days after the ticket was marked as spam. Deleted spam stays in the Recycle Bin, where it can still be restored. A ticket restored from the Recycle Bin is not deleted again by this rule. Mark contacts as spam automatically Once this many of a contact's tickets are marked as spam, the contact's email addresses are blocked too. Spam tickets before the contact is blocked From 1 to 50 tickets. Save spam settings Parent and child tickets When a parent ticket is closed Leave its child tickets open Agents can still choose to close the child tickets with the parent. Close all of its open child tickets Every open child ticket is closed right after the parent. Do not close it while a child ticket is open Agents must close the child tickets first, or close them together with the parent. Reopening a child ticket also reopens its parent. Close the parent when its last child ticket is closed The parent ticket closes on its own once none of its child tickets is open. Save
p.Time Tracking: /settings/tickets/time-tracking ::  Time Tracking How time entries are billed by default, and whether a timer runs on its own while agents work a ticket. Billing preferences New time entries are Non-billable Billable Cost of billable time No default cost Agents enter the rate or cost on each entry. Hourly rate Billable time is charged at one rate per hour. Fixed cost per entry Each billable entry carries the same additional cost. These are defaults for new entries — from the form and from a stopped timer. Agents can still change them on an entry. Timer Start the timer automatically A timer starts when an agent opens a ticket they can work on. Pause it when the agent leaves the ticket When they open another ticket, the paused time is logged and a new timer starts there. Save
p.Data Archive: /settings/data/archive ::  Data Archive Move old archived tickets out of the live Desk into archive files, and bring one back when you need it. Once a day, tickets that have been archived for the number of days you choose are written into an encrypted archive file and removed from the live Desk, so lists, search and reports stay fast. Their attachments are kept with the archive. Tickets on legal hold are never moved. You can find any archived ticket here and bring it back. Archive rule Which tickets leave the live Desk. Move old archived tickets to archive files Move a ticket when it has been archived for days A ticket is archived on the Ticket Archiving page, or by hand. New activity on a ticket un-archives it, so a ticket only moves here after it has stayed quiet. Discard Save Archives One file for each batch of tickets moved. Created Tickets Tickets closed Size Status No archives yet Archives appear here once the archive rule has moved tickets. Find an archived ticket Search every archive by ticket number, subject or contact. Type to search every archive.
p.Data Retention: /settings/data/retention ::  Data Retention Delete old data automatically, on one schedule for the whole company. Each rule you switch on moves matching records to the Recycle Bin once a day. Records on legal hold are skipped. Closed tickets Delete closed tickets after Years Months Days Between 1 month and 20 years. A year counts as 365 days and a month as 30. Off. Closed tickets are kept until someone deletes them. Finished activities Delete finished activities after Years Months Days Between 1 month and 20 years. A year counts as 365 days and a month as 30. Off. Finished activities are kept until someone deletes them. Contacts and accounts with no tickets Delete them when unchanged for Years Months Days Between 1 month and 20 years. A year counts as 365 days and a month as 30. Off. Contacts and accounts are kept until someone deletes them. Discard changes Save Runs No run yet. No runs yet There is nothing to display here yet. Legal holds Add hold A legal hold only stops the automatic deletion. People can still delete a held record by hand. A hold on a contact or an account also protects its tickets. No legal holds Put a ticket, a contact or an account on hold to keep it out of the automatic deletion.
